title: Geologic map of the Ladson quadrangle, Berkeley, Charleston, and Dorchester Counties, South Carolina
citation: Weems, R.E., and Lemon, E.M., 1988, Geologic map of the Ladson quadrangle, Berkeley, Charleston, and Dorchester Counties, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQ-1630, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Page 3 is OCR of the full map sheet; columns of text are interleaved on each OCR line and many passages are garbled (Ten Mile Hill and Ladson unit headings, Wando clayey facies, Ladson barrier sand facies, much of the Tertiary text column). Only legible fragments were used; map symbols were mostly lost and are assigned from the text (flagged inferred). Auger-hole log columns (LA 19, LA 4, LA 16, M-TL, etc.) are not legible enough to record intervals. Pages 1-2 are the cover and a standard symbol sheet. References with garbled or truncated citations were recorded only by their legible first line; Cronin, Hazel, Gibbes, Cooke, Shackleton, Sloan, Thornbury, Miller and others were skipped or only partly legible.
